secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs the session cookie. Development placeholder generated by Base44.

secrets.name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Encrypts the Pronote token (AES-256-GCM) before storage. Development placeholder generated by Base44.

secrets.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
secrets.description: DeepSeek API key — powers AI task generation and execution. Get it from https://platform.deepseek.com (API Keys page).

secrets.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Composio API key — powers Gmail/Calendar/Drive integrations. Get it from https://composio.dev (Settings → API Keys).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL — needed for account login/signup and data persistence. Find it in your Supabase project dashboard (Project Settings → API → Project URL). Run supabase.sql in the SQL editor first to create the tables.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key — bypasses RLS for server-side writes. Find it in your Supabase project dashboard (Project Settings → API → service_role secret).
